cells.gaps: In November 2026 the governor said banks and fintechs are still being brought onto Pay Na-Na and that a National Electronic Payment Switch joining banks, fintechs and mobile money operators is targeted for the first quarter of 2027 (LBR-028); this outdates the August 2026 statement that the system carried payments across banks and mobile networks (LBR-010).
cells.note: The instant payment system has connected the two mobile money networks since December 2025 (LBR-002, LBR-027), so 4. The governor said in November 2026 that banks are not yet on it and the national switch is due in 2027, so not 5.
